headline: Fisherman's Row and Stonecradle Keep Fronts Boiling
war_summary: Since the last edition, Fisherman's Row has posted the busiest recent ledger, with six ownership events in the latest two hours to Stonecradle's five and Godcrofts' three. Linn Mercy added two more, lifting its day tally to twenty. Weathered Expanse, still the leading region on the rolling day count with fifty-nine events, has recorded none in the latest two-hour window; Stlican Shelf, with fifty on the day, has likewise gone quiet. Fisherman's Row and Godcrofts each stand at thirteen events over six hours, while Stonecradle shows nineteen in that span. Callahan's Passage has reported no base-ownership events since late morning; Farranac Coast and Viper Pit have not resumed their earlier action. No faction yet commands the thirty-four victory towns required, and the war remains undecided.
